entities.name: PMID:27509565
observations: Prospective pretest/posttest quasi-experimental evaluation of two-hour teamwork training in simulated cardiopulmonary arrest events; 73 team members participated.

TEAM scores increased from 3.2 (SD 0.5) to 3.7 (SD 0.4) by participant rating and from 3.0 (SD 0.5) to 3.7 (SD 0.3) by trained-observer rating; both P<.001. No control group was reported in the abstract.

entities.name: Two-hour training raised TEAM scores
observations: In a 73-person simulated-arrest pre/post study, two-hour teamwork training was followed by increased TEAM scores: participant ratings 3.2 to 3.7 and observer ratings 3.0 to 3.7 (both P<.001); no control group was reported.
